cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(gt2_recomp C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)

# Recompiled output will go here - generated by psx-recomp / mips2c
# file(GLOB RECOMP_SRC src/recomp/*.c)

add_library(gt2_runtime STATIC
    runtime/gtfs.c
    runtime/bios.c
    runtime/gte.c
    runtime/gpu.c
    runtime/overlay.c
)

add_executable(gt2
    src/main.c
    # ${RECOMP_SRC}
)

find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
target_include_directories(gt2 PRIVATE runtime)
target_link_libraries(gt2 PRIVATE gt2_runtime m ZLIB::ZLIB)
target_link_libraries(gt2_runtime PRIVATE ZLIB::ZLIB)

# Toolchain note: use psx-recomp to generate src/recomp/* from /tmp/opencode/SCUS_944.88 + GT2.OVL.decompressed
# Example:
#   psx-recomp --exe /tmp/opencode/SCUS_944.88 --base 0x80010000 --out src/recomp/scus.c --config tools/recomp.toml
